Class OnixSettingReorderableEnum.Entry

Namespace
OnixRuntime.Api.OnixClient.Settings
Assembly
OnixRuntime.dll

Represents a single entry among the OnixSettingReorderableEnum The value is something you can pick at runtime to help you identify what a specific save id or index mean. SaveId is what is used for saving, the value is not saved, only the order is.
